description: Selected preservation-first refinement of the existing Kling-based composition; piecewise hold/exit timing and original audio. No new generation.

overlay.format: VP9 CRF8 YUVA420P alpha, silent; straight source-over

safari.format: High-quality animated WebP with lossless alpha

anchor.placement: The pixels are unshifted on the full source canvas. Apply top-left (-6,-30) ONCE at 1920x1080 reference scale. For matchStage W,H: s=min(W/1920,H/1080); origin=((W-1920*s)/2,(H-1080*s)/2); top-left=origin+(-6*s,-30*s); size=(1920*s,1080*s). Do not crop, stretch, or apply the derived top-left twice.

dim.note: MUST call playMatch with dim:false; doInCode:false/opacity:0 alone still triggers the old 0.3 fallback.

fadeOut.curve: Original authored cosine alpha exit, extended by the source-time map; baked in both visual formats. Do not fade twice.

endState: Fully transparent final frame; stop visual and audio and clean up on shared duration boundary or cancellation. No held result dim.

sfx.source: Exact approved retimed WAV, encoded without further timing/gain edits. Play only one audio format. MP3 container includes encoder padding; gapless decoded duration is the shared duration.

provenance.sourceIdentity: Original composition preserved; registered genuine source-art detail only inside existing emblem silhouettes

integrationStatus: Asset-only export. Repository and game unchanged. See INTEGRATION.txt for required no-dim/placement handling; metadata anchors are not automatically honored by the current loader.
